title: Principal AI Engineer

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Develop and standardize agent engineering capabilities, including orchestration, tool integration, memory management, and multi-agent workflows.

All About You  
Deep expertise in Data Engineering, AI Engineering, or Machine Learning platforms, with a proven track record of delivering production-grade AI solutions at scale.
  
Strong understanding of modern AI architectures, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, agent frameworks, orchestration patterns, and LLM-powered applications.
  
Experienced in designing and building scalable data pipelines, data products, APIs, and distributed systems that support AI and analytics workloads.
  
Demonstrated technical leadership with the ability to influence architecture decisions, mentor engineers, and drive the adoption of engineering best practices across teams.
  
Passionate about solving complex business problems through innovation, with a pragmatic approach to balancing speed, quality, security, and operational
  
Proven ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into enterprise-scale platforms, reusable services, and measurable business outcomes.
  
At least an undergraduate degree in CS, or a STEM related field
  
Prior experience in payment fraud detection modeling
  
  
Nice to have:
  
PhD/Master’s in CS, Data Science, Machine Learning, AI or a related STEM field
  
Experience in with data engineering and model building in PySpark using Spark ML on petabyte scale data
  
Understands and implements methods to evaluate own work and others for bias, inaccuracy, and error

description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Senior Product Support Engineer
  
PeopleSoft Billing Agent (Bill-to-Cash Agentic Platform)
  
Global Bill-to-Cash Operations — JLL Technology Centre of Expertise (location/shift TBD)
  
  
**What this job involves:**  
About the role
  
#JLLTechAmbitions
  
The Bill-to-Cash (B2C) Agent automates Phase 2 of the IFM APAC (GGN India) billing process — ingesting client billing templates emailed by CFMs, analyzing and decomposing them into invoice groups, validating each group against SOP and PeopleSoft business rules, and raising temp/proforma invoices in PeopleSoft. It replaces a manual and RPA-based process (currently ~48-hour turnaround time, 86,000+ transactions per year across 500+ client accounts) with an event-driven, multi-agent pipeline hosted on AWS (Strands Graph on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime), integrating with M365/SharePoint, PeopleSoft (via APIM), Datadog, and Power BI.
  
JLL is seeking a Product Support manager to own day-to-day operational support of this platform across non-production and production environments — monitoring pipeline health, triaging failures and exceptions, coordinating fixes with Engineering, and acting as the operational point of contact for FinOps and Ops. Communication is key: this role requires clear triage, timely escalation, and clean handoffs across Engineering, FinOps, and Ops stakeholders in a global (APAC/EMEA) support model.
  
Responsibilities
  
Monitoring & Alerting
  
Monitor pipeline health using Datadog (APM, metrics, logs) and CloudWatch (native AWS monitoring, GenAI Observability) across all pipeline components — API Gateway, Lambdas, EventBridge, SQS, AgentCore Runtime, Aurora Postgres
  
Respond to CloudWatch alarms and Datadog alerts on node, tool, or component failures within defined response times
  
Track AWS Bedrock LLM cost and usage against budget alerts
  
Incident & Exception Handling
  
Triage pipeline exceptions using the handoff CSV (per-invoice-group pass/fail status, failing node, failing rule) and the linked SharePoint SR folder
  
Distinguish between transient/infrastructure failures (retry, escalate to Engineering) and business-rule/data failures (route to FinOps per the “restart, not resume” model — corrected templates re-enter as a new SR)
  
Monitor the SQS Dead-Letter Queue and work with Engineering to identify and resolve stuck or failed messages
  
Ensure success, partial-success, and exception notifications (via SendGrid) are reaching FinOps as expected
  
SLA & Throughput Management
  
Track adherence to the T+1 business-day SLA for temp invoice creation from successful receipt of the billing template
  
Use the Power BI Ops dashboard (sourced from Aurora via EDP Sync) to monitor throughput, latency, and exception volume, escalating any degradation trends
  
Monitor for month-end volume peaks (steady-state ~7,000 invoice transactions/month) and flag scaling or capacity concerns
  
Data & Reference Integrity
  
Monitor the scheduled Refresh Lambda that mirrors SOPs/mappers (SharePoint → S3) and PeopleSoft reference data (project config, addresses, tax codes, service types → Aurora), and confirm refresh jobs complete successfully
  
Escalate any signs of stale reference data being served, given the requirement that accrual checks always run live and the system must never silently serve stale or incorrect financial data
  
Support root-cause investigation when reference data discrepancies (e.g., address resolution, tax code mismatches) drive validation failures
  
Environment & Release Support
  
Support Dev, UAT, and Production environments (all AWS us-east-1), including coordination of deployments via the standard dev-UAT-prod SDLC
  
Verify IaC (Terraform)-provisioned resources are healthy post-deployment
  
Participate in Snyk/Wiz security scan remediation coordination as needed
  
Audit & Compliance Support
  
Support FinOps and Engineering with queries against the append-only PipelineStepLog (Aurora) audit trail (input, output, confidence score, and status per pipeline event) for audit or investigation requests
  
Ensure no financial content is inadvertently routed outside approved channels (e.g., confirming Datadog exports remain metrics/logs/traces only, per data classification requirements under Policy 27)
  
Continuous Improvement
  
Feed recurring failure patterns (e.g., frequent validation rule breaches, template classification misses) back to Engineering and FinOps for SOP, mapper, or client-recipe updates
  
Support AgentCore Evaluations by flagging live incidents that may indicate golden dataset gaps
  
Purpose of the Role
  
Own day-to-day operational support of the billing agent pipeline: proactively monitor node/tool health, respond to alerts, and triage and resolve (or escalate) failures within SLA
  
Ensure Ops and FinOps teams can rely on accurate, timely temp invoice creation
  
Support Dev, UAT, and Production environments under the direction of Engineering and FinOps leadership
  
Act as the operational point of contact for FinOps/Ops, ensuring clean handoffs between Engineering, FinOps, and Ops
  
  
**Sounds like you? To apply you need to be:**  
Experience & Education
  
Experience in production/application support for cloud-hosted, event-driven systems (ideally AWS)
  
**Working knowledge of AWS services:** Lambda, SQS/DLQ, EventBridge, S3, Aurora Postgres (or equivalent RDBMS), API Gateway
  
Understanding of, or willingness to learn, PeopleSoft billing/invoicing concepts (temp/proforma invoices, HSN codes, GST/tax codes, address sequence codes) — training will be provided via the SOP repository
  
Technical Skills & Competencies
  
Familiarity with observability tooling — Datadog and/or CloudWatch (dashboards, alarms, log search)
  
Comfortable reading structured logs/JSON payloads to triage failures (SQL for Aurora queries a plus)
  
Familiarity with Microsoft 365 / SharePoint / Graph API-based workflows is a plus
  
Exposure to AI/LLM-based or agentic systems (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore) is a plus but not required
  
**Strong incident-management discipline:** clear triage, timely escalation, and clean handoffs
  
Comfortable working across Engineering, FinOps, and Ops stakeholders in a global (APAC/EMEA) support model
  
Ability to identify risks and issues and propose solutions effectively
  
Self-starter able to execute with minimal supervision; ability to work autonomously, but as a team contributor
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  
  
**What success looks like:**  
Alerts acknowledged and triaged within agreed response windows
  
Exceptions correctly routed (Engineering vs. FinOps) with minimal back-and-forth
  
T+1 SLA breaches identified early and escalated proactively, not discovered after the fact
  
No incidents of stale/incorrect financial data being served without detection
  
Clean, actionable input into Engineering/FinOps on recurring failure patterns
  
  
**What we can do for you:**

Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your ambitions in career, recognition, well-being, benefits, and pay.
  
Join us to develop your strengths and enjoy a fulfilling career full of varied experiences. Keep those ambitions in sight and imagine where JLL can take you…

**Data Engineering & Operational Real-Time Integration**

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* GenAI Specialization: 2+ years of specific experience building and deploying LLM-based applications or Agentic Systems in production.

* Database & Lakehouse Mastery: E xperience architecting storage layers for AI, including Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate , Qdrant ), NoSQL/Relational Databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB), and modern Data Lakehouses (specifically Databricks or Snowflake).

* LLM Ecosystem: F amiliarity with common LLM frameworks and orchestration libraries (e.g., LangGraph , LangChain , CrewAI , AutoGen ). You understand the mechanics of RAG, embeddings, and context window management.

* Hybrid Engineering Skillset: A unique blend of Data Science (understanding model behavior, probability, and prompting) and Software Engineering (CI/CD, API design, asynchronous programming, and system reliability).

title: Global L&D Innovation Director
description:

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As the Global L&D Innovation Director, you will lead the innovation engine within BCG's Global Learning & Development Strategy & Transformation Office. Reporting to the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Senior Director, you will run a ringfenced innovation team focused on identifying, prototyping, and PoC testing the next generation of online learning experiences for BCG.

BCG's L&D model is evolving to deliver faster, more personalized, data-informed, and AI-enabled upskilling in support of BCG's 2030 strategy. You will be a critical leader in making that roadmap real, helping stand up the innovation team and tech squad, pilot adaptive learning, develop agentic learning prototypes to scale new products and experiences over time.

You will lead work across three connected domains:

* Innovation portfolio management - shaping the intake, prioritization, sequencing, governance, and delivery discipline for a portfolio of high-priority L&D innovation initiatives
* Experimentation and product development - leading the development and validation of new audience-facing learning experiences, products, formats, and AI-enabled solutions
* Implementation and scaling - partnering across L&D, Talent, IT/Product, and business stakeholders to move successful pilots into durable products, programs, platforms, or operating routines

The work will include experimentation with AI tools, AI workflows and automation for L&D internal transformation, and prototyping and piloting of agentic and adaptive learning experiences aligned to the 2030 L&D strategy. You will help BCG shift from slower, programmatic learning cycles toward rapid upskilling in short cycles - weeks, not years - particularly for emerging business needs and technical skills.

What You'll Bring

* 10+ years of experience in innovation, product management, digital transformation, learning transformation, talent/capability building, strategy execution, or enterprise program leadership
* Experience leading teams in complex, global, matrixed environments, with a strong track record of coaching, developing, and mobilizing talent
* Demonstrated ability to move work from ideation through design, build, pilot and value proof.

* Curiosity and the desire to change the status quo.
* Strong technology literacy, including comfort working with AI-enabled tools, digital products, workflow automation, learning platforms, or data-enabled solutions
* Experience managing a portfolio of initiatives with competing priorities, limited resources, and senior stakeholder visibility
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional partners, and manage tradeoffs with sound judgment
* Experience working with agile, product-led, design-thinking, test-and-learn, or rapid prototyping approaches
* Strong problem-solving and structured thinking, with the ability to bring clarity to ambiguous or fast-changing topics
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to translate technical or conceptual ideas into clear business and learning implications
* Comfort operating at both strategic and executional levels - you can set direction and personally help get the work done
* Experience in L&D, talent, capability building, HR transformation, or professional services is preferred, but not required for candidates with strong innovation, product, or transformation experience
* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred

Who You'll Work With

You will report to the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Senior Director and lead the innovation team within the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Office.

Your direct leadership scope will include the ringfenced innovation team responsible for developing and validating new learning experiences, products, formats, AI-enabled workflows, and agentic/adaptive prototypes. This team will act as a rapid experimentation and delivery capability for the L&D organization, helping relieve pressure from teams managing structured curricula and foundational programs while responding to accelerating demand for digital and AI upskilling.

You will work closely with:

* L&D Strategy Implementation & Transformation to align innovation priorities with the broader 2030 L&D roadmap, governance, investment choices, and transformation milestones
* Rapid AI Adoption teams to connect innovation efforts with urgent business-critical skill needs, AI upskilling priorities, and emerging technical capability requirements
* L&D Business Partners to understand demand from BCG's cohorts, businesses, regions, and functions and translate that demand into prioritized innovation opportunities
* Learning Architecture and Curriculum teams to ensure successful pilots can be embedded into learning journeys and sustained beyond the innovation team
* Learning Product and Operations teams to transition proven solutions into scalable delivery models, platforms, processes, and operating routines
* IT, Product, Data, and AI teams to ensure prototypes and pilots are technically feasible, well-integrated, secure, and aligned with BCG's broader technology ecosystem
* HR, Talent, and People Strategy teams to connect learning innovation to broader skill, performance, talent, and workforce priorities
* Vendors and external partners where third-party platforms, content, tools, or technical capabilities can accelerate delivery

Together, you will help BCG build a faster, more adaptive, more technology-enabled learning ecosystem - one that strengthens our world-class apprenticeship and faculty-led learning while creating scalable, personalized, data-informed learning experiences for the future.

Additional info

**YOU'RE GOOD AT-**

* Taking ideas from concept to implementation - You can start with an ambiguous business or learning need, shape the problem, define the opportunity, mobilize the right people, test a technical solution, and evaluate what is needed to drive adoption and scale.
* Running a high-quality innovation portfolio - You bring structure to fast-moving work. You can manage intake, prioritization, resourcing, stage gates, decision rights, dependencies, risks, and handoffs without slowing the team down.
* Leading agile, multidisciplinary teams - You know how to lead teams that may include a mix of learning designers, product owners, technologists, data and analytics colleagues, AI specialists, vendors, and business SMEs. You create clarity, energy, accountability, and momentum.
* Applying technology and AI pragmatically - You are tech literate and curious. You do not need to be an engineer, but you can engage credibly with technical teams, understand what AI and digital tools can and cannot do, and translate emerging capabilities into usable learning solutions.
* Building solutions that are learner-centered and business-backed - You can connect business goals to skill needs, translate those needs into learning experiences, and keep outcomes at the center of the work.
* Collaborating across a complex ecosystem - You can operate in a global, matrixed environment and build strong partnerships with L&D Business Partners, Learning Architecture, Product and Operations, Talent, HR, IT, Product, and senior business stakeholders.
* Managing stakeholders with confidence and judgment - You know how to shape demand, negotiate tradeoffs, communicate progress, surface decisions, and keep stakeholders aligned across seniority levels and functions.
* Experimenting with discipline - You are comfortable with rapid prototyping, piloting, feedback loops, and iteration, but you also know when to stop, pivot, scale, or hand off.
* Leading people through ambiguity and change - You build trust, coach teams, manage performance, and help people do excellent work in a space where priorities, tools, and expectations are evolving quickly.
* Translating innovation into adoption - You understand that a successful prototype is only valuable if it is used. You think ahead about change management, communications, enablement, measurement, and integration into existing workflows.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

**About the Role**
  

We are looking for an experienced Quality Engineer with 6\+ years of experience to design, build, and execute automated test solutions across enterprise applications. You will bring strong test automation skills combined with solid domain knowledge — embedding quality as a first\-class concern across Agile delivery teams. This is a hands\-on technical QE role requiring strong coding ability, deep automation framework expertise, and a shift\-left quality mindset.

* Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks covering UI, API, integration, and E2E testing layers.
* Develop automation scripts using Selenium WebDriver or Playwright supporting functional, regression, and cross\-browser testing.
* Build and maintain REST API test automation suites using RestAssured, Karate, or Postman covering API contracts and business logic validation.

* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines implementing quality gates that prevent defective code from reaching production.
* Champion shift\-left testing practices engaging with developers and architects early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Design and execute performance and load tests using JMeter or Gatling validating application scalability under realistic load conditions.
* Manage defect triage and reporting logging, prioritising, and tracking defects in Jira with clear business impact assessment.
* Mentor and coach junior QE team members sharing automation expertise across the team.

* 6\+ years of quality engineering experience with strong hands\-on technical automation expertise.
* Strong automation skills using Selenium WebDriver or Playwright building scalable, maintainable frameworks from scratch.
* Solid Java or Python skills writing production\-quality test automation code.
* Proven REST API testing expertise using RestAssured, Karate, or Postman.
* Experience with BDD frameworks including Cucumber and Gherkin for business\-readable test scenario automation.
* Strong CI/CD integration experience embedding quality gates into Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions pipelines.
* Good SQL skills for data validation and reconciliation testing.
* Strong shift\-left testing mindset engaging early in the delivery lifecycle to define testability and quality requirements.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills working effectively across developers, product owners, and DevOps teams.

* Performance and load testing experience using JMeter, Gatling, or k6\.
* Contract testing experience using Pact or Spring Cloud Contract.
* Accessibility testing knowledge including WCAG standards and Axe tools.
* AI assisted testing tools including Mabl, Testim, or Applitools.
* ISTQB Foundation or Advanced certification.
* Experience in Financial Services, Banking, or regulated industry environments.
